correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and A Smith-equivalent to diag(I_(n-1),0), a bordered unit-entry matrix realizes A+EdF stably equivalent to I_(n-2) plus C=[[1+dvu,df],[-e,0]]. The two-by-two Smith exponents are i=min(alpha,beta,gamma), j=min(t,beta+gamma-i), including alpha=beta=gamma=t and zero divisors; rank-one update cannot affect the n-2 unit factors. For uniform u in R^(n-1), the primitive event has probability 1-q^(-(n-1)); conditional on it v.u is uniform in R, otherwise 1+v.u is a unit. Consequently alpha has mass b_m,t(0)=1-(1-q^-m)/q and b_m,t(k)=(1-q^-m)a_t(k) for k>=1, independent of beta,gamma, which have a_t(k). Summing their joint masses over valuation triples gives the complete Smith-type law and q^(2nt) times probability the ordered pair count, independent of chain-ring isomorphism or d unit. The statement concerns structured corank-one update, not arbitrary matrices.
